description: Measure the distance from the modelled fatty acid in 7AIA to the mapped canonical G-site and to the CMT residues reported as ligand-proximal
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
 'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','MSE':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
txt=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/7AIA.cif",timeout=60).text
lines=txt.splitlines(); i=0; prot={}; het=[]
while i<len(lines):
    if lines[i].strip()=='loop_' and lines[i+1].strip().startswith('_atom_site.'):
        cols=[]; j=i+1
        while lines[j].strip().startswith('_atom_site.'): cols.append(lines[j].strip().split('.')[1]); j+=1
        idx={c:k for k,c in enumerate(cols)}
        while j<len(lines) and not lines[j].strip().startswith(('loop_','#','_')):
            f=lines[j].split()
            if len(f)>=len(cols) and f[idx['pdbx_PDB_model_num']]=='1' and f[idx['label_alt_id']] in ('.','A'):
                resn=f[idx['label_comp_id']]; c=f[idx['auth_asym_id']]; resi=int(f[idx['auth_seq_id']])
                nm=(f[idx['auth_atom_id']] if 'auth_atom_id' in idx else f[idx['label_atom_id']]).strip('"')
                xyz=[float(f[idx['Cartn_x']]),float(f[idx['Cartn_y']]),float(f[idx['Cartn_z']])]
                if resn in AA3 and c=='AAA': prot.setdefault(resi,{'aa':AA3[resn],'xyz':[]})['xyz'].append(xyz)
                elif resn=='RF8' and c=='AAA': het.append(xyz)
            j+=1
        break
    i+=1
LA=np.array(het); print("RF8 (hexadecanedioic acid) heavy+H atoms in chain AAA:",len(LA))
def mind(resi):
    if resi not in prot: return np.nan
    return float(np.linalg.norm(np.array(prot[resi]['xyz'])[:,None,:]-LA[None,:,:],axis=2).min())
GSITE=[31,34,36,39,70,71,72,73,74,75,76,77,78,89,90,91,134]        # mapped canonical G-site (iteration 1)
CMT_LIG=[111,227,239,240,282]                                       # residues called 'proximal to the hydrophobic ligand', PMID 42953386
POCKET=[46,235,236,238,242,243,244,282,286,287,288]                 # measured RF8 contacts, iteration 1
OTHER_CMT=[120,218,310,37,218]                                      # assorted CMT residues not claimed proximal
rows=[]
for grp,lst in [('mapped canonical G-site',GSITE),('CMT residues called ligand-proximal (PMID 42953386)',CMT_LIG),
                ('measured RF8 contacts (iteration 1)',POCKET),('other CMT residues',sorted(set(OTHER_CMT)))]:
    for r in lst:
        rows.append(dict(group=grp,res=(prot[r]['aa']+str(r)) if r in prot else f"?{r}",min_dist_to_RF8=round(mind(r),2)))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(D.to_string(index=False))
print("\nmedian distance by group:\n",D.groupby('group').min_dist_to_RF8.agg(['count','min','median','max']).round(2).to_string())
hit=D[D.group.str.startswith('CMT residues called')]
print("\nOf the 5 CMT residues called ligand-proximal, %d are within 5 A of the modelled fatty acid: %s"%(
    (hit.min_dist_to_RF8<5).sum(),list(hit[hit.min_dist_to_RF8<5].res)))
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.4,4.4))
cols={'mapped canonical G-site':'#2a6ebb','CMT residues called ligand-proximal (PMID 42953386)':'#f08c00',
      'measured RF8 contacts (iteration 1)':'#d7263d','other CMT residues':'#8d99ae'}
for i,(g,sub) in enumerate(D.groupby('group')):
    ax.scatter([i]*len(sub),sub.min_dist_to_RF8,color=cols[g],s=45)
    for _,r in sub.iterrows(): ax.annotate(r.res,(i,r.min_dist_to_RF8),fontsize=6,xytext=(5,-2),textcoords='offset points')
ax.axhline(5,ls='--',color='k',lw=1); ax.text(2.6,5.4,'5 A contact cut',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(range(D.group.nunique())); ax.set_xticklabels([g.replace(' (','\n(') for g in sorted(D.group.unique())],fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylabel('minimum distance to the modelled fatty acid in 7AIA (A)')
ax.set_title('Where the crystallographic fatty acid sits relative to the canonical site\nand to the CMT residues called ligand-proximal')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
